pages.text: BiblioWoods recipes appear automatically for supported wood mods. Use each wood’s matching planks and slabs to craft furniture with that panel. For recipes with a furniture ingredient, use a piece with the same panel.

pages.title: Supported Woods
pages.text: Biomes O’ Plenty contributes 13 wood families, Forestry CE 43, and either supported Natura port 13. Use one Natura port at a time. Installed sources with supported woods appear as separate BiblioWoods creative tabs.

pages.title: Missing Materials
pages.text: If a source mod is removed, its recipes disappear and existing furniture uses the default frame texture. Its saved panel survives, so restoring the source restores the texture. Use the $(l:bibliocraft:materials/framing)paneler$(/l) to change the finish.
